raw.query: WITH targets(run_id, series) AS (VALUES ('sweeps:llm_burst1_aic_s1'::text, 'language calibrated'::text), ('sweeps:llm_burst1_poly_s1'::text, 'language polynomial'::text), ('sweeps:vision_burst1_s1'::text, 'vision calibrated'::text)) SELECT t.series, d.run_id, d.window_name, d.window_span_s, d.window_requests, d.tp, d.is_current AS dim_is_current, d.superseded_by, p.sla_metric, p.p99_ms, p.n_requests AS latency_requests, p.queue_divergent, p.is_current AS latency_is_current, i.bound_stat, i.bound_ms, i.achieved_p99_ms, i.achieved_p99_ms / i.bound_ms AS bound_multiple, (i.bound_ms - i.achieved_p99_ms) * 100.0 / i.bound_ms AS percent_under_bound, i.is_violation, i.has_raw_backing, i.is_current AS infraction_is_current FROM targets t JOIN provenance.v_dim d ON d.run_id = t.run_id AND d.is_current = true JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p ON p.run_id = t.run_id AND p.is_current = true JOIN provenance.v_infraction i ON i.run_id = p.run_id AND i.sla_metric = p.sla_metric AND i.is_current = true WHERE (t.series IN ('language calibrated', 'language polynomial') AND p.sla_metric = 'ttft') OR (t.series = 'vision calibrated' AND p.sla_metric = 'encoder_delay') ORDER BY t.series
